---
name: Bug report
about: Something went wrong
labels: bug
---

**Error code (if shown)** — the code in the error toast, e.g. `429` `401` `503`
(what each code means: ERRORS.md):

**Thalamus version** — the release tag you installed, e.g. `v0.1.0-beta`
(visible in the GitHub Releases page and in the installer filename):

**Windows version** — e.g. Win 11 23H2:

**What happened?** — what you did, what you expected, what you saw:

**Details line (optional)** — the dim technical line under the error, if visible:

**Provider / model (optional)** — e.g. "OpenAI gpt-4o" or "Ollama llama3.2", and
whether the model was local. Do **not** paste API keys.

<!--
Logs stay on your machine by default. If you want to attach them:
%APPDATA%/com.thalamus.desktop/logs — only attach what you are comfortable sharing.
-->
